book.name: 2 Timoti
book.title: 2 Timoti Pol re Timoti rene yuri basrasem siglow.

content: An Pol, an Krais Jisas reri werasem tame. God re wem, an Krais Jisas rene omuteke habobo tatame remne God reri wem tuma wesowbo, rem heyar temente tetane.
Timoti, ne ari yen sekene, an nene gwor siglow basrasbo. Apiy Godkene nemri Haneyen Krais Jisas, rep nene pap meten kwobo late. Rep kemri pap pultete, ne pap yenbo temente.
Nem God Reri Tuma Yenbo wesowte, nem sebera kap yate.

Ari yeiwarege rem pap yenbo ten God Reri Tuma meten reri yaku heyar nenbemkap, an etopwou nenbo. An habobo, an wule yenbo nenbo. Kwokwos kwokwos, neirkene yabelkene, an God rekene tuma narembo wule an nene habon God rene nerene wese abo, rene wemetbo, re nene heyar nenbet.
Neren kiramkap, an etop sene habobo, eker an nene tekatekabo, an nene sene late selbo. An nene late, an okbopwai tete.
An heyar mettene, ne Krais rene omuteke habobo. Opkap wule neri owyi Loiskene neri nawo Yuniskene rep heyar etop sebem. Be yabel an neri omuteke habobokap habobo,

an neri wuribai op lisokote habobo. Kiyi an neri tarek let kerem, God re nene kitimena bukre wuri newom. Tame rem ker lisen ker re ein wayen bukre tebokap, neren potem kitimena ne God reri yaku yenbo nenbet, er kitimena re sene bukre tete tetane.

Ne mettene. God re Reri Wow nemne newom, nem be akbo. Yehow. Re nemne kitimena potbo wule kirkir newom. Re nemne agerbo tatame remne pap meten heyar nenbo wule kirkir newom. Re nemne wuribai yaper kebasi sewaibo wule kirkir newom.

Opkap, ne nemri Haneyen reri tuma wesowte, ne sebera kap yate. An Haneyen reri tame, eker rem anne ake yaperke wen wurem. Ne etop sebera kap yate. An God reri yaku nenen mus metbokap, ne God reri kitimena poten reri Tuma Yenbo wesowen ne mus kirkir mette.

God re nemne reri tatame tete wepotem. Nerem nenbem yaku yenbok boker re nemne sene wepotem. Yehow. Reri wuribaike re nemne pap meten kwobo lan sene potem. Kiyisapewai re nowsel be nenmenem, re nemne habon Krais Jisas eterke nemne potte wem.

Sene God reri pap metbo wule re tegek tem. Nemne Sene Potem Tame, Krais Jisas, re yam, re tame sabo wule teitkwunem. Re God Reri Tuma Yenbo nemne wesowbem. Eker nem mettene, tatame rem rene omuteke habote, rem sene be sate, rem heyar somsom temente tetane.
God re anne leban anne God Reri Tuma wesowte wem. Eker, an reri werasen yi tame tem, an reri tuma peikbo tame tem.
Eker, an gwopkap mus metbo, an sebera be yabo. Yehow. Aren omuteke habobo tame rene an mettene. Re anne newom yaku re heyar lakeren yin re sene yate Yabel tete.

An nene peikbem tuma sekene ne heyar habobet. An nene peikbemkap, ne agerbo tatame remne etop kirkir peikbet. Ne Krais Jisas rene omutekewai habote. Neri pap ne rene newote. Op nente, ne tatame remne tuma yenbo wesowte.
God re neri letke rasem Tuma Yenbo ne heyar lakerete. God Reri Wow re nemri wuribaike tetane. Eter re nene kwobo late, reri kitimenak ne er wos heyar lakerete.
Ne metem, nugwape Esia nowselri tame rem anne magel tayen anne mesegenen yim. Tame pes, Figeluskene Hermogeneskene, etep mere rep anne mesegenem.

Onesiforus re etop be nenem. Yehow. Tewo nugwape re anne lasyabem, an pap kwuye metbem. Op nenem, an Haneyen rene wemetbo, re rene reri yentakene remne pap mette. An ake yaperke temenem, re anne lasyate be aken sebera be yam.
Yehow. Re Rom kwomke yam yabelke re anne sopen yin anne ek lam.
Ne metem. Kiyi an Efesus kwomke temenem, re anne kwobo labem. An Haneyen rene wemetbo, re tatame remne tuma nente Yabel re Onesiforus rene pap meten rene heyar nente tetane.
